neighbours.label: auxiliary 'be/are/being' that opens a passive verb phrase (are vaccinated, to be used, are being replaced)
fire: Most of the old school buses are being replaced by electric models this year.
These seeds should be planted in early spring after the last frost.
New patients are screened for allergies before any treatment begins.
Plastic bags will be banned in all city shops starting next month.
The leftover food is collected and donated to local shelters each night.
Applications must be submitted online before the end of the week.
Older adults are advised to get a flu shot every autumn.
Many of these medicines are prescribed for children under five.
quiet: The city is replacing most of the old school buses with electric models this year.
Gardeners plant these seeds in early spring after the last frost.
Nurses screen new patients for allergies before any treatment begins.
The city will ban plastic bags in all shops starting next month.
Volunteers collect the leftover food and donate it to local shelters each night.
Applicants submit their forms online before the end of the week.
Doctors advise older adults to get a flu shot every autumn.
Pediatricians often prescribe these medicines for children under five.

notes: card: ' be' x12, ' are' x6, ' being', mostly before a past participle in health/policy text. Probe: passive 'are vaccinated' 0.23, active 0.01. The - pole also peaks on ' be'/' to' but in obligation or negated frames ('should not be construed', 'have to think'). Near misses: active voice, same content.
